title: Thai Veggie Ground Tacos with Peanut Sauce & Cucumber Slaw

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.

Juice lime into the bowl with the cilantro. Add half of the peanut sauce, water, and salt; stir to combine the dressing and set aside. (Place remaining peanut sauce in a small bowl and set aside for serving.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie ground, curry paste, and salt; cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl, along with the shredded cabbage, and stir to combine the slaw. Set aside.
When the veggie ground is done, add additional water to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thickened, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with veggie ground and a small portion of the slaw. Drizzle tacos with reserved peanut sauce and serve with remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!
